scope: Synthetic offline archives only. No actual CI artifact, connector transfer, repository edit, staging or network mutation.
checks: Raw ZIP, binary members, CRLF logs, metadata and SHA-256 seals preserve exact bytes; failed run/job/command statuses stay failed.
Missing source metadata and missing command receipts remain explicit incomplete evidence.
Mismatched source, run, attempt, archive digest and nonzero PASS reject before installing output.
Push event is mandatory and artifact names bind the exact head, run ID and selected attempt; old C2 names and other-attempt artifacts reject.
All four full-shard identities bind artifact/job/source/command; counts and failures remain reported, filtered or wrong-shard commands reject, and a missing JSON result remains INCOMPLETE.
Root comparison validates accepted49 and its exact tree; the prior accepted138 baseline rejects.

The extended browser artifact requires sixteen receipts, including all four added full suites and both split files under one recorded command; each new missing receipt stays explicit and failures remain failed.

Actual recorded argv and source both bind the two enabled flags, explicit msedge override and complete split file selection; disabled flags, another channel, filtered commands and wrong named suites reject. CRLF command text remains supported.
Missing split metadata/results, a missing selected test file and skipped guarded bodies remain INCOMPLETE; byte verification still grants no test PASS.
Traversal, absolute/drive/backslash paths, symlinks, duplicate names, case collisions, file/directory collisions and Windows reserved names reject before extraction.
